Name: Jael
Summary: Jael was the wife of Heber the Kenite, whose tent became the unlikely end of Canaan's feared general Sisera. Deborah's song calls her most blessed among women.
KeyStory: When Sisera fled the battle and sought shelter in her tent, Jael gave him milk and a place to rest — then drove a tent peg through his temple while he slept, ending twenty years of oppression.
LifeLesson: Jael's courage came in an ordinary tent, with ordinary tools, in a moment she did not plan. God can use whoever is willing, right where they are, to break a long oppression.
